questions.question: What is food defined as in the article?
options: Any substance that is consumed by an organism for nutritional support
Any liquid that is drunk by an organism
Any material that is used for building shelter
Any object that is used for entertainment
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states: 'Food is any substance that is consumed by an organism for nutritional support.'
Incorrect. The article does not define food as a liquid; it says food is a substance consumed for nutritional support.
Incorrect. The article does not mention building shelter; it defines food as a substance consumed for nutrition.
Incorrect. The article does not mention entertainment; it defines food as a substance consumed for nutrition.
